# Wellesley Centers for Women

> > A premier women and gender-focused research institute advancing social justice, gender equality, and women's empowerment through rigorous scholarship and evidence-based action.

Wellesley Centers for Women (WCW) is the largest women-focused research institute in the United States, based at Wellesley College. The organization conducts transformative research on gender equality, violence prevention, youth development, and women's status while fostering international collaboration with scholars and practitioners worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Gender equality
- Women's research
- Social justice
- Human rights
- Violence prevention
- Youth development
- Women's empowerment
- Economic empowerment
- Mental health research
- International scholars
- Research publications
- Policy briefs
- Women and girls status
- Peacebuilding
- Evidence-based action

## Core Resources

- [Wellesley Centers for Women](https://www.wcwonline.org): Homepage for Wellesley Centers for Women, a premier women and gender-focused research institute.
- [About us](https://www.wcwonline.org/About-us-Extra-Information/about-us): Mission, vision, and organizational overview of WCW as largest women-focused research institute.
- [Our Research](https://www.wcwonline.org/research): Overview of WCW research programs addressing gender equality, violence prevention, and youth development.
- [People](https://www.wcwonline.org/Scholars-Trainers/Active-Researchers): Directory of WCW research scientists, project directors, and active researchers.

## Research & Publications

- [Publications](https://www.wcwonline.org/Publications/publications): Searchable database of WCW publications including policy briefs, journals, and fact sheets.
- [Research & Action Report Display](https://www.wcwonline.org/Research-Action-Report/research-action-report-display): Annual Research & Action Report showcasing WCW initiatives and research findings for donors.

## News & Events

- [News & Events](https://www.wcwonline.org/News-Events/news-a-events): News and events hub featuring research updates, scholar highlights, and upcoming programs.
- [Calendar of Events](https://www.wcwonline.org/Calendar-of-events/calendar-of-events-all): Calendar of upcoming WCW events including seminars, virtual events, and expert speaker series.
- [Women Change Worlds Blog](https://www.wcwonline.org/WCW-Blog): Women Change Worlds Blog featuring research commentary and women's perspectives on social issues.
- [Recent Coverage](https://www.wcwonline.org/Recent-coverage/recent-coverage): Media coverage and featured articles by WCW researchers including Charmaraman and Pekkala.

## Featured Research & Stories

- [New Comprehensive Report on the Status of Women and Girls in Massachusetts](https://www.wcwonline.org/2026/new-comprehensive-report-on-the-status-of-women-and-girls-in-massachusetts): Report on women's status in Massachusetts covering wage gaps, education, and health disparities.
- [Amnesty International USA Honors Pashtana Durrani](https://www.wcwonline.org/2025/amnesty-international-usa-honors-pashtana-durrani): News article on Pashtana Durrani receiving Ginetta Sagan Award for women's rights in Afghanistan.
- [Leading Scholars and Practitioners Unite to Harness Mothers' Soft Power for Peace](https://www.wcwonline.org/2025/leading-scholars-and-practitioners-unite-to-harness-mothers-soft-power-for-peace): Colloquium event featuring scholars on mothers' role in peacebuilding and violence prevention.
- [From Healing and Truth to Research and Action](https://www.wcwonline.org/2025/from-healing-and-truth-to-research-and-action): Coverage of Kate Price's book release on human trafficking and survivor advocacy.
- [NIOST's Georgia Hall Advises Carnegie Foundation on R&D Agenda to Transform American High School](https://www.wcwonline.org/2025/niost-s-georgia-hall-advises-carnegie-foundation-on-r-d-agenda-to-transform-the-american-high-school): News on Georgia Hall advising Carnegie Foundation on high school transformation research agenda.
